name: brand-design
description: Build and evaluate brands grounded in cultural authority — strategy, identity, voice, and stewardship — across three seats: an aspirational Muse (the gravitational pull toward an ideal), a maker (methodology + extended voice work via the brand-writer agent), and an adversarial named-critic Council (check-brand-council, an instance of this plugin's own domain-neutral council-rules machinery, fanning out persona-inlined judge dispatches through an optional chair-moderated deliberation round). User-invocable skills: make-brand, make-brand-muse, make-brand-guidelines, make-brand-stack, make-critic, make-council, check-brand-orientation, check-brand-rubric, check-brand-council, file-brand, file-brand-corpus. make-critic mints one new critic persona into an existing council (the .name-map.md gitignored attribution discipline lives there); make-council stands up a whole new council instance for a different domain, citing council-rules throughout. Methodology/evaluation/corpus/guidelines/council-mechanics knowledge are skills, cited by the procedures rather than restated. Portable across Claude Code/Cowork and a single-context Claude Project: a brand-corpus MCP gives per-instance retrieval, backed by a corpus-resolution ladder (MCP tools → filesystem → Claude Project knowledge) every procedure declares its own mode against — degrading to filesystem-only where bundled scripts are load-bearing, sequential persona simulation for the council, or an in-chat ledger elsewhere. Self-contained.
